name: Size normalizer
author: Lienzo UI
description: Makes buttons and sibling elements the same size, or rounds all sizes to even numbers, keeping each element centered.

commands.name: Equalize all buttons
commands.description: Every Button gets the width and height of the largest one.

commands.name: Equalize sibling widths
commands.description: Same-kind siblings take the width of the widest one.

commands.name: Equalize sibling heights
commands.description: Same-kind siblings take the height of the tallest one.

commands.name: Equalize sibling sizes
commands.description: Same-kind siblings take the largest width and height of their group.

commands.name: Make sizes even
commands.description: Rounds every width and height to an even number of pixels.
